notes: The albums that came back with songs still missing are fixed: an album is now rebuilt with every song carrying its album tag, including songs another album also holds, and a missing album is rebuilt whatever other albums have claimed its songs.

Single-song albums are albums too: a released single that the cleanup had removed is rebuilt like any other album, and the whole rebuild runs on every start so anything still missing is found on the next launch rather than never.

Deleting an album yourself is still yours to do: the app remembers the albums you removed on purpose and never brings those back, while everything the old cleanup took keeps coming back until it is all there.
The lyrics letter wave, the timed lyric lines, the music player and the home-screen widget are all untouched by this release.
Everything 73.1.8 shipped stays: albums can be searched, renamed and reordered in Manage albums, and an album the app cleared still waits there with an It is mine button that puts it back whole.
Your files are exactly where they were: every song stays in the library with its album tag, and nothing in this release moves, renames or removes a song.
